description: Lignes électriques moyenne tension (HTA) is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Géo2France (Géo2France). This dataset makes it possible to visualise the geographical location of the medium voltage overhead and underground power line sections of the distribution networks. The High Voltage A or HTA (or Medium Voltage) can be between 1,000 volts (1 kV) and 50,000 volts (50 kV). In principle, it is 20 kV in France. Coverage: Géo2France (Géo2France). The portal shows the English title as "Medium Voltage Power Lines (HTA)" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Géo2France (Géo2France). Its keywords include donnee-ouverte, sources-denergie, nord, hauts-de-france, energie, amenagement. The listing shows 1 download or service links in OGC:WMS. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
